model.title: Veo 3.1 Fast
model.shortDescription: Faster and more cost effective version of Google's Veo 3.1!
model.pricingInfoOverride: For every second of video you generate you will be charged **$0.10** without audio or **$0.15** with audio for 720p or 1080p. At 4k, you will be charged **$0.30** per second without audio, or **$0.35** with. For example, a **5 second video** at **1080p** with **audio on** will cost **$0.75**.
